description: A hybrid self-report assessment assembled by Meg Guerreiro (2017) from existing cognitive-engagement measures to assess students' reported cognitive engagement, including in grades 6–8 mathematics.

description: A set of five research-based pedagogic methods developed by CREDE for effective, culturally responsive teaching across grade levels, learner populations, and content areas.
title: Center for Research on Education, Diversity and Excellence (CREDE) pedagogic methods

description: A planned Long Beach Unified School District entity that provides tutoring, mentoring, cultural programming, wellness services, legal aid, career support, and advocacy for Black students and families.
title: Center of Black Student Excellence

description: A GARP-based qualitative ecological model library developed by Anders Bouwer and collaborators to simulate Cerrado vegetation succession, population dynamics, and fire-management effects through composable model fragments and scenarios.
title: Cerrado Succession Hypothesis (CSH) qualitative model library

description: CETSOL VR Clinic is a virtual-reality simulated learning environment developed to provide trainee radiographers and medical imaging practitioners with guided or free-speech practice in empathic MRI patient communication.
title: CETSOL VR Clinic
